googleBackupDisclosure: Off by default. Connect only if you want to store project snapshots, their linked World Bible, and attachments in your own Google account. Only this app’s private backup area is accessible—not your ordinary Drive files. Your writing is not sent to the developer. Backups use your Google storage; local writing always works without Google.
googleBackupTesting: Preview: Google authorization is currently limited to approved test accounts. This is an explicit backup/restore feature, not live cloud editing or automatic synchronization.
googleBackupUnsupported: Google sign-in cannot run directly from a downloaded HTML file or an unregistered website. Use the Windows launcher, Android app, or official hosted web app. You can still move complete projects with local ZIP files.
googleBackupPrepare: Enable Google sign-in for this session
googleBackupConsent: I understand the optional Google connection and want access to my private app backups. No writing uploads until I choose Back up this project.
googleBackupEmpty: No completed backups are listed. Refresh to check your account.
googleBackupRetention: Every upload creates a new snapshot; interrupted uploads do not replace an older backup. Restoring always adds a separate project and never overwrites your current work. Disconnect clears this session; to revoke access or remove hidden backups, use Google Account permissions or Drive → Settings → Manage apps. Removing hidden data permanently deletes those backups.
